story.title: Plymouth Parkway beat Berkhamsted to reach FA Cup second round
story.summary: Two Andrew Neal penalties sew Plymouth Parkway earn a first-ever trip to the second round of the FA Cup after a coming from a goal down to beat Berkhamsted 2-1 in extra time.
